body.p: A bird and a mouse. A bird fell in love with a mouse's daughter. The bird married the mouse's daughter. After that the bird started to live in the mouse's hole. The winter came. The snow fell. All the birds flew away to warm places. Only one bird stayed in the cold place. It is cold in winter, they have no food. The bird has lost its force. The bird got sad. It is lying in the mouse's hole, it is sleeping all the time. The bird's bones ache. Day after day, day after day, the mice see the force of the bird is running out.[ShA:] Maybe not nu, but ÅoÊ 'One' was meant. The bird's tail is frozen to the ground. The mother mouse said to her daughter: "Cut off the bird's wings." The mouse's daughter cut her husband's wings. The bird is lying on the same place. The bird lost her force completely, the mouse cut her head, she cooked the bird's head like food. The bird got into the bad eye of the sky (i.e. the spirit of the sky punished it). For leaving its bird mates (it was punished).
